text: Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova urged the WTA to stay out of Saudi Arabia, citing rights groups' claims about the treatment of women and taboos around homosexuality, as the PIF partnership was announced.
short: Evert and Navratilova urged the WTA to stay out of Saudi Arabia

source.name: Tennis.com
source.quote: Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova are among those who urged the WTA to stay out of Saudi Arabia
